chapter: Family and life on the road
title: Two-cent residual check
summary: Residuals; a two-cent Gold Diggers check he kept uncashed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Do you ever get residuals or anything like that?
You know what? Yeah, sometimes. And I have — in fact I have one in my drawer here that I keep I think it’s from — oh I don’t know where it is now but I think it’s from some
show that had a lot of girls on it, the Golden Girls or something like that? Or no it wasn’t that sitcom, this was a show, I forget, anyway —
Gold Diggers, yeah. It was some kind of show like that. And I got a residual for two cents. So I kept the check, I didn’t cash the check.
Well good. If retirement is in your future then you’re all set.
